title: Strategy & Structure shaping facilitation
description:
# Open Call: Strategy & Structure Facilitator – Astral Ship

As we prepare for the upcoming season, we are opening a call for a skilled facilitator with experience in strategy, organisational development and planning to join Astral Ship for a short residency of up to five days. 

The purpose is to work closely with **Liza and Liam, supporting them in setting up the strategic direction, organisational structure and goals for Astral Ship’s upcoming season and 2027**. 

Through a series of focused, collaborative workshops, the resident will help them bring clarity to their ideas, define shared priorities, establish a basic organisational framework, and translate broader ambitions into tangible goals that volunteers and the wider community can work towards. 

The process will also look at planning future voyages and outreach activities, as well as clarifying the relationship and potential synergies between Astral Ship and Engedi. The aim is not to deliver a complete long-term strategy within five days, but to give Liza and Liam the tools, structure and initial roadmap to carry this process forward. 

**Residency conditions:** Free accommodation and €50 per day towards food and utilities.
